title: Job: The Wicked Proseper

questions.question: What question does Job ask regarding the wicked?
options: Why do the wicked live, reach old age, and grow mighty in power?
questions.correctAnswer: Why do the wicked live, reach old age, and grow mighty in power?
questions.explanation: Job 21:7 (ESV): "Why do the wicked live, reach old age, and grow mighty in power?"

questions.question: Their houses are safe from what?
questions.explanation: Job 21:9 (ESV): "Their houses are safe from fear, and no rod of God is upon them."

questions.question: They spend their days in prosperity and in peace they go down to what?
questions.explanation: Job 21:13 (ESV): "They spend their days in prosperity, and in peace they go down to Sheol."

questions.question: What do they say to God?
options: Depart from us! We do not desire the knowledge of your ways.
questions.correctAnswer: Depart from us! We do not desire the knowledge of your ways.
questions.explanation: Job 21:14 (ESV): "They say to God, 'Depart from us! We do not desire the knowledge of your ways.'"

questions.question: What is the Almighty, that we should what?
questions.explanation: Job 21:15 (ESV): "What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? And what profit do we get if we pray to him?"

questions.question: How often is the lamp of the wicked put out?
options: Job asks "How often?" implying it is rare
questions.correctAnswer: Job asks "How often?" implying it is rare
questions.explanation: Job 21:17 (ESV): "How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out? That their calamity comes upon them?"

questions.question: You say, 'God stores up their iniquity for' whom?
questions.explanation: Job 21:19 (ESV): "You say, 'God stores up their iniquity for their children.' Let him pay it out to him, that he may know it."

questions.question: One dies in his full vigor, being wholly at ease and what?
questions.explanation: Job 21:23 (ESV): "One dies in his full vigor, being wholly at ease and secure,"

questions.question: Another dies in bitterness of soul, never having tasted of what?
questions.explanation: Job 21:25 (ESV): "Another dies in bitterness of soul, never having tasted of prosperity."

questions.question: They lie down alike in the dust, and the what covers them?
questions.explanation: Job 21:26 (ESV): "They lie down alike in the dust, and the worms cover them."

questions.question: Have you not asked those who what?
questions.explanation: Job 21:29 (ESV): "Have you not asked those who travel the roads, and do you not accept their testimony?"

questions.question: The wicked man is spared in the day of what?
questions.explanation: Job 21:30 (ESV): "that the wicked man is spared in the day of calamity, that he is rescued in the day of wrath?"

questions.question: Who declares his way to his face?
questions.explanation: Job 21:31 (ESV): "Who declares his way to his face, and who repays him for what he has done?"

questions.question: When he is carried to the grave, watch is kept over the what?
questions.explanation: Job 21:32 (ESV): "When he is carried to the grave, watch is kept over the tomb."

questions.question: The clods of the valley are what to him?
questions.explanation: Job 21:33 (ESV): "The clods of the valley are sweet to him; all mankind follows after him..."

key_verse_text: Why do the wicked live, reach old age, and grow mighty in power?
